subject: HealthLynk: ML infra & embed+gen pipeline — recap & next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@healthlynk.com>, Priya Rao <priya@healthlynk.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: HealthLynk discovery — infra & embed+gen pipeline recap

Samir / Priya — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick written summary to make sure we’re aligned and to capture concrete next steps. I’ve bolded the asks and items that need decisions.

High-level goal
- HealthLynk wants to automate claim triage and pre-fill structured fields for downstream adjudication with a hybrid embedding + generation pipeline. Primary objectives are higher accuracy on reranking (reduce false positives), consistent structured output for downstream systems, and stable latency for peak hours.

Top pain points you emphasized
- Rerank quality varies across claim types (medical vs dental) — current heuristic approach gives noisy top-3.
- End-to-end tail latency spikes (95th often > 300ms on peak), causing UI timeouts for internal users.
- Need deterministic structured outputs (JSON schema) to avoid manual mapping — sometimes the model emits free text that requires manual QA.
- PHI and security constraints: must run in VPC + audit logs retained for 1 year.

Integration fit / recommended approach we discussed
- Embeddings for candidate retrieval (dense vector store) -> lightweight lightweight reranker -> generation with a structured-output schema enforced via function-call / structured_output param.
- Streaming enabled for generation path so downstream UI can render partial structured fields as they arrive (time-to-first-field).
- SDK change: add a streaming=True path + callback that emits partial JSON tokens; also provide an optional structured_output schema param we ship as a small JSON schema.

Minimal PoC scope (proposed) — confirm these 3 items:
1) Data: HealthLynk provides a 3k-sample test set (anonymized) of claims and desired structured outputs.
2) Metrics: Target 95th gen latency < 200ms (streaming to first field), top-3 rerank MRR improvement >= 15% vs current baseline, and end-to-end cost estimate per 1k requests.
3) Environment: Run PoC in Redwood Dedicated VPC with audit logging turned on.

Action items (who / when)
- Samir: Share anonymized sample dataset + three representative edge cases (by EOD Wed, Nov 2). (ACTION: Samir)
- Jonas: Draft PoC checklist and resource estimate (ACTION: Jonas) — can you include an ops play for streaming fallbacks?
- Ben: I’ll loop in Solutions Eng to lock down SDK callback shape and share a small reference for structured_output schema.
- Samir / Priya: Confirm compliance signoffs required (SOC2 report / any contract amendments) so we can scope Private deployment.

Deliverables we’ll provide
- PoC checklist (Jonas)
- Minimal SDK changes doc + sample call snippet (Redwood)
- Quick cost-band estimate for projected volumes (Redwood)

Attachments: healthlynk_sample_cases.csv (placeholder — Samir to provide), redwood-poc-template.md (attached template we use for similar PoCs).

I’ll schedule the deep technical session for next week — please volunteer preferred windows.

Thanks,
Hannah

Subject: Re: HealthLynk discovery — infra & embed+gen pipeline recap

Hannah — thanks for the clear write-up. Confirming and adding detail below.

Confirmations / clarifications
- We can provide an anonymized extract (~3k rows) of claims and the canonical structured outputs. I’ll upload the file to the Drive link you provided by tomorrow. (ATTACHMENT: healthlynk_sample_cases.csv)
- Edge cases we care about: overlapping diagnoses, attached physician notes (multi-paragraph), and missing codes. We’ll flag 20 of those as high-priority.
- PHI: yes — running in a VPC is non-negotiable for the PoC. We will need encryption-at-rest, KMS integration, and logging.

Technical asks from our side
- Streaming: important for our internal UX — we want first actionable field to appear within 100–200ms. If full structured JSON takes longer, partial emission is okay as long as fields are emitted in a stable order.
- Function calls: we want the model to return extracted actions (e.g., {"action": "request_documents", "fields": ["xray", "lab_report"]}) as a typed call so we can programmatically route.
- Rerank: ability to combine dense embeddings + a small learned reranker (we can provide labels for a 1k training subset).

Constraints / risks
- Procurement window: we need an internal signoff by mid-December to align with vendor onboarding.
- Volume: initial rollout ~5k/day, scaling to 50k/day in Q2 — include cost bands in your estimate.

Next steps (from us)
- I’ll upload the sample dataset and a short doc with 3 priority workflows by EOD tomorrow.
- Priya will attend the deep-tech session — available Thu/Fri next week mornings (PST).

Thanks — Samir

Looping in a concise PoC checklist draft (high level) so we can move fast once HealthLynk uploads data. I’m attaching a spreadsheet stub (PoC-Checklist.xlsx).

Proposed PoC checklist (items)
- Ingest: sample CSV -> vectorize (Redwood endpoint) -> index in eval vector store (staging).
- Retrieval: implement dense retrieval + candidate filter (business rules).
- Rerank: small learned reranker (train on 1k labels) with A/B to their heuristic today.
- Generation: call with structured_output schema; streaming enabled to callback.
- Fallbacks: if streaming fallbacks trigger or partial JSON malformed, we return a stable minimal summary and enqueue full pass async.
- Security: KMS key binding to their tenant, audit-level logging (retention policy 1 yr).
- Success criteria: 95th gen latency to first-field <200ms, top-3 MRR +15% vs baseline, and integration test coverage for schema conformance.

Resource estimate (rough)
- 1 SE (Ben) + 1 Solutions Eng (Hannah) for integration + 0.4 FTE infra for 2 weeks to provision dedicated staging.

Questions for contract/ops
- Do they require a formal SOC2 review prior to PoC or is the PoC allowed under NDA? (Hannah — you asked them to confirm).

I’ll refine the spreadsheet and share as PoC-Checklist.xlsx.

Jonas
